Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Research Scientist II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) post at SCTIMST is scheduled for 22nd September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Clinical Research, Health Sciences, Public Health, Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Science, or Biotechnology with relevant experience, or a PhD, or a Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm D.) with specified experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) position is 40 years as of 01st September 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for candidates with experience in Government Research Organizations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) position at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this SCTIMST recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the SCTIMST office in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for candidates with experience in Government Research Organizations?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates who have prior experience working in Government Research Organizations.
